title: report.py stacks --output-mode json
description: One table of DNS provider stacks (dns_providers grouped by provider_id; a provider declaring none belongs to no stack and is left out), at most --limit rows. Support is a distribution over the stack's probed deployments, not an average (GitHub issue #160), per template version and per template (GitHub issue #251); supported_templates and their changes count templates any deployment supports, changes replayed over full sweeps only (GitHub issue #219); domains describe the selected import, named in the note.

rows.description: Ordered by domains (descending) when a domain share is selected, otherwise by deployments descending. Empty when there are no DNS providers.

name.description: providerName of the stack's first deployment, falling back to the stack's providerId, then '?'.

provider_id.description: The stack's providerId (dns_providers.provider_id of its deployments).

deployments.description: dns_providers rows in the stack, probed or not.

domains.description: Sum of the deployments' domains in the selected import; null without a domain share or when no deployment has a measurement.

deploymentTemplateSupportPct.description: The same distribution over templates, any version counted once (GitHub issue #251): over the stack's deployments with at least one probe answer (supported_count + unsupported_count > 0), supported_templates / every stored template (the rows of report.py service-templates), as a percentage. null when no deployment has an answer.

deploymentSupportPct.description: Over the stack's deployments with probe combinations: supported / total combinations, as a percentage. null when no deployment has any.
